rdfs:label: available
rdfs:comment: The date or period when the resource became (or will become) available.
notes: Distinct from `urn:solid:issued` (formal publication): `available` is when the resource starts to be obtainable, which can differ from publication for embargoed papers, scheduled releases, or pre-orders. Typically an xsd:date or xsd:dateTime; a period may be given as an ISO 8601 interval literal or a `urn:solid:PeriodOfTime`.

history.note: Dropped xsd:dateTime range (value may be a date or a period); clarified permitted value forms in notes.
